world: a frozen snow kingdom with ancient stone ruins and mythical beasts
characters: Kael: 19-year-old male scout, athletic build, messy dark hair, piercing blue eyes, wearing a rugged wolf-pelt parka, leather bracers, and carrying a carved bone bow. Lyra: 17-year-old female scholar, silver-blonde braided hair, copper goggles resting on forehead, wearing a thick teal fur-lined coat with an antique glowing brass compass. Frostgale: Colossal mythical six-legged snow feline beast covered in thick white fur, with glowing crystalline antlers and luminous cyan eyes.
title: Part 1: The Sky Shatters
summary: Siblings Kael and Lyra investigate the sudden shattering of the sun and discover ancient ruins holding a legendary six-legged frost beast. When a sinister black frost attacks, the temple floor collapses, plunging the siblings and the mythical creature into a hidden subterranean kingdom.

title: Frost Realm: Part 2 - The Subterranean Kingdom
summary: Kael, Lyra, and Frostgale plunge into a hidden underground crystal kingdom filled with ancient shadow warriors and a terrifying obsidian beast. While Frostgale fights to protect them, the siblings discover a shocking secret about their missing father and the shattered sun.
